Inventing or falsifying lab or research data. b. Inventing or falsifying a bibliography. c. Any other action defined as fabrication by a Faculty Member or the University. Misuse Misuse shall mean unauthorized use or utilization of any academic privilege with respect to library books, notes/slides shared by the teacher, question papers, intellectual property, answer sheets etc. Forgery Forgery shall mean an act to imitate or counterfeit documents or signatures.
